author: Jeff Geerling
description:
I thought I had the best time. Then someone brought over a cesium atomic clock, and I wasn't sure.

Segal's law: "A man with a watch knows what time it is. A man with two watches is never sure."

Some of the things I mentioned in the video:

  - VCF Midwest: https://vcfmw.org
  - ShadyTel: https://shady.tel
  - Meinberg GPS Antenna: https://www.meinbergglobal.com/english/products/gps-antenna-converter.htm
  - Pumping Station One: https://pumpingstationone.org
  - Tattler Solutions WOPR rackmount display: https://tattlersolutions.com/wopr/
  - Duchtronix AVR Scope Clock: http://www.dutchtronix.com/ScopeClockH3-1-Enhanced.htm
  - My TrueTime Pi configuration: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2026/truetime-xl-gps-time-server-restomod/
  - MacMesh: https://macmesh.xyzzy.computer
  - Mr. Macintosh: https://www.youtube.com/c/MrMacintoshBlog
  - L2J video on the Prototype Apple Network Server 300: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tupEO0mrf0c
  - Quadra 800 MiSTer FPGA core: https://github.co
title: I found an atomic clock at the world's largest vintage computer show
